prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Das Nest", the secret hideout of three street kids inside an old round water tower tank. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image. Keep the whole room within the central part of the image; the far left and right margins are plain curved riveted metal wall. The floor is a large round area of wooden planks laid over the steel tank bottom, covered with patched rugs - the large walkable area, warm and uncluttered in the middle.
TOP WALL (curved riveted steel, cut away): covered in children's crayon drawings pinned up with tape (shapes only, no letters), and a big hand-drawn map of the city made of taped-together paper sheets with coloured string and pins - the most eye-catching spot; fairy lights and a string of tin-can lanterns.
LEFT SIDE: three cosy sleeping nooks built from mattresses, blankets, pillows and cardboard walls, each different (one with stickers, one with stuffed toys, one very tidy).
CENTER slightly lower: an upturned wooden crate used as a card table, with sitting cushions around it.
RIGHT SIDE: a big worn armchair with a fluffy blanket (a guest seat), next to it a tiny tea table with mismatched cups; upper right a leaking spot in the ceiling with a dented bucket under it catching drips.
LOWER LEFT: a low table with pots and bowls for dinner.
BOTTOM CENTER edge: a round floor hatch with a ladder going down - the exit.
Warm yellow lantern light mixed with a little pink and cyan neon from a small window slit. Cosy, messy, safe.
